About the clinic

These are the people you want helping your family.

Hamilton Prosthetics & Orthotics is a family-owned clinic serving London and Southwestern Ontario since 1988. Our certified prosthetists, orthotists, and registered nurse work together under one roof, with an in-house fabrication lab for faster turnaround.
